description: Read or set a project's 'look in post' flag. Use it when the person grades in DaVinci Resolve with the FilmLab Look plugin and wants the lens and film look applied there instead of baked into the generated pictures. With project_id only: read. With look_in_post true, image and video prompts of the project no longer ask for grain, halation, vignette, chromatic aberration or soft edges — the plugin adds them in Resolve; false puts them back. It takes effect only while a LensLab lens set is chosen for the project (Pose Director / camera panel in the FilmLab app); without one the flag is stored but changes nothing. The answer always carries look_in_post, optik (the chosen lens set or null), wirkt (whether it takes effect now) and a sentence to pass on.

look_in_post.description: true: leave the look terms out of prompts and let the Resolve plugin add them; false: keep them in the prompt. Omit to only read

name: lab_look_in_post
